repository_evidence: shared health aura is linked at reset after 5s; first recharge begins at 10s
controller shuffles all four golem GUIDs per encounter
heroic only summons Lord Victor Nefarius
10-player Arcane Annihilation selects one random target; 25-player casts area spell
Electrical Discharge chain target is random and damage gains 20% per jump
Acquiring Target selects one random target
Poison Bomb samples up to 25 random eligible targets, excludes within 10yd of summoner when alternatives exist, then fixates one
Nefarius manipulates only the longest-active golem and uses an internal 30s ability cooldown
Reset/FAIL/DONE paths remove encounter debuffs and forward DONE credit
round 2: Electrical Discharge starts on a random player through the 95499 trigger
round 2: two Acquiring Targets and two Poison Protocols per activation; Toxitron shields at 50/40 s like the other constructs
route kill attribution needs the credit creature 42180 as route source_entry

phase_graph.prepull: Controller summons four inactive constructs (Inactive 78726, Powered Down 82265, not selectable); 10 s after reset the first queued construct recharges (45 s normal) and then walks its patrol, attackable, without Activated.
phase_graph.engage: Any construct entering combat: IN_PROGRESS, all constructs zone into combat, the patrolling construct receives Activated (90 s normal) and the next construct starts Recharging.
phase_graph.rotation: Every 45 s (normal) the next construct activates; each active construct shields once 50 s after activation (1.5 s cast, 10 s aura) and shuts down at 90 s (Shutting Down 3 s cast, then Inactive). Two constructs overlap except during the first 45 s.
phase_graph.end: Shared health reaches zero: every construct dies, the controller calls _JustDied (boss 1 DONE); credit creature 42180.
phase_graph.wipe: A construct evading despawns all constructs, sets FAIL and respawns the controller after 30 s.

tanks: two tanks own at most one active construct each; ownership follows the construct's victim, a new construct goes to the tank whose construct is gone or shutting down
taunt an owned construct that attacks anyone else (a single-cast allowance when it is shielded; natively the taunt procs only Power Conversion, one Converted Power stack)
stop attacking an owned construct while it is shielded and drag it 12 yd from the other active construct
walk an owned construct out of a Power Generator (construct center >= 8.6 yd from it)
a free tank waits next to the construct whose Recharging aura ends within 12 s
interrupt: interrupt every Arcane Annihilator (79710) with a rotation by capability: in-range melee 10 s interrupts, then ranged, then tanks, then long cooldowns; a backup acts 450 ms into the cast; under Power Conversion the interrupt still lands and procs one Converted Power stack natively; the restriction is widened for that single cast only
dispel: poison dispellers (Cleanse 4987, Remove Corruption 2782; not a Bear Form tank) clear Soaked In Poison at 3+ stacks or below 50% health
ranged: kill a Poison Bomb only where its 6 yd blast reaches no player (or it already touches its target)
stand in the Power Generator when it is clear of hazards
raid: damage an active construct whose shield is spent this activation, else the newest active unshielded one; never damage a shielded or shield-casting construct (every construct entry is restricted per bot and only unshielded active constructs are allowed)
Lightning Conductor carrier keeps more than 8 yd from everyone; others keep out of its 8 yd
Acquiring Target player leads the Flamethrower cone away; everyone else leaves the 25 degree Magmatron-to-target cone
fixated player kites its Poison Bomb away from everyone
leave Chemical Cloud (12 yd), Poison Puddle (6 yd) and other players' bomb blast radius (6 yd)

bot_strategy.owns_node: only while a construct is engaged; the validation route approaches and pulls
bot_strategy.offense_authority: BotOmnotronOffenseAuthority.h: per bot, all four construct entries are restricted and only the plan's active unshielded constructs are allowed (direct casts refused, area spells refused beside a restricted construct); interrupts and taunts on a shielded construct run under a SingleCastAllowance that is restored right after the cast.
bot_strategy.damage_focus: A construct whose one shield of this activation was observed and has ended (BotOmnotronShieldLedger.h) is preferred; else the newest active unshielded construct. At steady state a construct receives no damage from ~16 s after activation until its shield ends, so DoTs (up to 21 s) expire before the shield; only the opening construct carries fresh DoTs into its shield.
